title: Man in Celestial Fog
description: A bearded man with dark wavy hair and a black t-shirt stands centered, looking upward as his hair blows dramatically. He is surrounded by swirling clouds of purple, pink, and white smoke beneath a spinning ceiling fan with motion blur and radiating golden light beams.
prompt: A bearded man with dark wavy hair wearing a black t-shirt stands in the center of a room looking up, his hair blowing upward. A spinning ceiling fan with heavy motion blur radiates golden light beams from above. Swirling clouds of purple, pink, and white ethereal smoke fill the lower half of the frame. The room has warm orange walls with several framed pictures. Cinematic lighting, surreal atmosphere, dramatic upward perspective.
